name: Seminole County Water Service Areas
notes: Public provider-boundary polygons. The layer itself notes uncertainty where roads form service boundaries.

name: Florida DEP Current Chemical Data
notes: Reported Safe Drinking Water Act chemical results, including inorganic contaminants.

name: U.S. Census Geocoder
notes: Used only to normalize an address and obtain coordinates.

name: Seminole County Situs Address Points
notes: County states address points are updated weekly. Optional secondary verification source.

name: Florida DEP Lead Service Line Inventory
notes: Address/building-specific service-line evidence where a utility publishes a matching inventory.

name: EPA ECHO / Safe Drinking Water Information System
notes: Federal system, facility, compliance, violation, lead-and-copper, site-visit, and enforcement context. EPA states that the downloadable SDWA data are refreshed quarterly.

name: EPA/USGS Water Quality Portal
authority: U.S. EPA, USGS, and participating agencies
notes: Nearby lake, stream, groundwater, source-water, and other environmental monitoring records. These are not automatically tap-water or PWS compliance samples.

name: Consumer Confidence Reports
authority: Community water systems / U.S. EPA / Florida DEP
notes: Annual utility reports with source-water, detected-contaminant, and compliance information. System-level, not household-level.
